Class LegacyUserDatabaseMigration

java.lang.Object
com.articulate.sigma.user.LegacyUserDatabaseMigration
public class LegacyUserDatabaseMigration extends Object
Migrates the legacy Sigma user database schema into the newer UserDatabase schema.
